panels.description: All distinct incidents, including records with invalid or missing response durations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(event_date) AS time, count() AS incidents FROM ems.fact_incident FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Incident volume by event date

panels.description: Only source-flagged valid and nonnegative durations enter each average. Counts show the denominator used.

targets.rawSql: SELECT borough, count() AS incident_count, countIf(dispatch_usable) AS valid_dispatch_count, round(avgIf(dispatch_seconds, dispatch_usable), 1) AS avg_dispatch_seconds, countIf(incident_response_usable) AS valid_incident_response_count, round(avgIf(incident_response_seconds, incident_response_usable), 1) AS avg_incident_response_seconds FROM ems.fact_incident FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY borough ORDER BY borough

panels.title: Response times by borough (seconds and valid denominator)

panels.description: Rows are grouped by initial call type while showing initial and final types side by side.

targets.rawSql: SELECT initial_call_type, final_call_type, count() AS incidents, countIf(dispatch_usable) AS valid_dispatch_count, round(avgIf(dispatch_seconds, dispatch_usable), 1) AS avg_dispatch_seconds, countIf(incident_response_usable) AS valid_incident_response_count, round(avgIf(incident_response_seconds, incident_response_usable), 1) AS avg_incident_response_seconds FROM ems.fact_incident FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY initial_call_type, final_call_type ORDER BY incidents DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Incident and response summary by call type

panels.description: Most recent stream ingestion timestamp; incident_datetime remains the source event time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(ingested_at), now()) AS seconds_since_ingest FROM ems.fact_incident FINAL

panels.title: Seconds since latest ingestion

panels.description: Invalid or missing durations remain in incident volume but are excluded from averages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS incidents, countIf(dispatch_usable) AS valid_dispatch, countIf(NOT dispatch_usable) AS invalid_or_missing_dispatch, countIf(incident_response_usable) AS valid_incident_response, countIf(NOT incident_response_usable) AS invalid_or_missing_incident_response, countIf(travel_usable) AS valid_travel, countIf(NOT travel_usable) AS invalid_or_missing_travel, countIf(NOT timestamp_order_ok) AS timestamp_order_issues FROM ems.fact_incident FINAL

panels.title: Validity and data quality

panels.description: Monthly averages use only source-valid, nonnegative measurements. Matching counts show each denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(event_date)) AS time, countIf(dispatch_usable) AS valid_dispatch_count, avgIf(dispatch_seconds, dispatch_usable) AS avg_dispatch_seconds, countIf(incident_response_usable) AS valid_incident_response_count, avgIf(incident_response_seconds, incident_response_usable) AS avg_incident_response_seconds FROM ems.fact_incident FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Dispatch and incident response averages by month
